scenarios.label: Small known-file correction
scenarios.prompt: Fix the upper-bound bug in mathpkg/clamp.go: Clamp(value,min,max) must return min below min, max above max, and value otherwise for min <= max. Preserve package, declaration, parameter names and all other files. Implement a pure function using only comparisons, if statements and returns; do not add calls, imports, declarations or side effects. Only mathpkg/clamp.go may change. Run the existing tests if possible without fetching packages. Report file, lower=Clamp(-5,0,20), inside=Clamp(10,0,20), and upper=Clamp(25,0,20) as JSON. Preserve existing file permissions and directories.
